description: The hooks of a custom reporter class under Jest 30.5.2 (B23a) for a run in which every test passes and `getLastError` returns nothing: `onRunComplete` sees `success=false` (Jest computes `success` only after the dispatcher has run `onRunComplete`, TestScheduler.ts L338-L352 and L486-L491), and the run exits 0. One Jest worker; the reporter is the only one. A black-box run.
